messages:
anna: Quick heads-up: AcmeCloud wants the legacy compatibility shim removed from marketplace bundles. They report packaging issues and perf regressions.

leo-partner: Their packaging pipeline doubles-encodes headers with the shim; adding ~50ms p95. They can move off it but need a clear timeline and packaging examples.

devon: Proposal: telemetry -> opt-in flag for new installs -> public advisory + 30d grace -> removal after 60d. Dedicated/private deployments get a separate path.

maria: I'll add `partner_shim_usage` metric and a partner-visible rollup. Need ~72h to deploy and one canary.

samir: For Dedicated/on-prem we need a manual migration runbook and a prebuilt rollback artifact. SI partners may request extended windows.

leo-partner: Marketplace metadata: add `shim_removed` boolean, `migration_notes` URL, and a deprecation badge in Console listing. Will help vendor ops.

devon: Console banner ticket open. We'll gate removal if active shim usage >= 3% globally or if partners with high usage haven't signed off.

anna: Agreement: telemetry (3d) -> feature-flag (1w) -> partner advisory -> 30d grace -> remove after 60d unless exception. Owners: maria (telemetry), devon (flag + console), samir (runbook), leo-partner (partner comms).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry agent canary deployed on infra-canary-3 (build 5489).

anna: Action: leo-partner draft partner email and schedule SI tabletop next Tue. Maria to post docs PR when ready. If blockers, report here. :thumbsup:
